alexander_p_harrison: Walter "Button" Harrison arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a book with the last pages torn out and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Walter "Button" Harrison wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Walter "Button" Harrison found a chair in the barn and sat down carefully, as if it might be reserved for someone of higher rank. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Walter "Button" Harrison answered to number 814.
aquaboy66: They issued Konrad Aquaboy a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a stub of a pencil in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Konrad Aquaboy began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
The reply to Konrad Aquaboy's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Konrad Aquaboy in the open at R-S13. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Rafael Official of the Concord (@deutsches_kaiserreich_official). Konrad Aquaboy stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-S13. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Rafael Official of the Concord (@deutsches_kaiserreich_official).
Edmund Aquaboy arrived carrying the family name of Konrad Aquaboy. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

The telephone went dead during the shelling. Edmund Aquaboy watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Edmund Aquaboy is number 480. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
archiegregorysmith: Bram Archiegregor arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a bullet that missed him and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
Edmund Potato of the Hegemony and Bram Archiegregor of the Concord watched a broken branch near Calvary Farm all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch.

A flare caught Bram Archiegregor halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. The Concord took Verdel Ridge, and the orders at S-F17 changed before the cheering ended. Bram Archiegregor shouldered another load.
A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Sunken Road. Bram Archiegregor fired. Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
A newspaper reached Bram Archiegregor with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Bram Archiegregor tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F17 is up. Bram Archiegregor fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Zeno Ramsey, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Bram Archiegregor watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Bram Archiegregor fired at a movement across the wire at S-F17. The man went down: Tobias Hellcat, grazed.
The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Bram Archiegregor approved the method.
Bram Archiegregor fixed the strap on Arno "Crow" Hakkinen's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

A bullet hit Bram Archiegregor in the neck at S-F17. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper of the Hegemony (@josiascouper). Bram Archiegregor was killed at S-F17 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper of the Hegemony (@josiascouper).
Roland Archiegregor put a bullet that missed him beside the bunk. Someone who had known Bram Archiegregor helped clear the shelf without saying why.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F17 they left Roland Archiegregor behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin of the Hegemony (@demirkeskin06).
Quentin Archiegregor came to the front because his older brother Roland Archiegregor never came home. He carries a bullet that missed him.

Quentin Archiegregor tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Marrow Fen. Every version sounded like the ration bell. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin Archiegregor is number 160. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
chivrex1945: The draft reached S-R8 on Day 9. Jonas "Rabbit" Chivrex was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Jonas "Rabbit" Chivrex took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Marek Man, grazed. Jonas "Rabbit" Chivrex walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Jonas "Rabbit" Chivrex put a folded ration label under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
francescsequera_: Nils Francescsequ stepped off the supply cart at Q-F12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Nils Francescsequ watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Asked what he will do after the war, Nils Francescsequ said: 'Be a choir singer in Oakmere. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
freejstax: The old hands of T-F14 have been here since Day 1. Karel "Spark" Freejstax has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Karel "Spark" Freejstax read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Karel "Spark" Freejstax carried Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey's rifle all the way up to Grey Mill after Owl twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
kaijkrause: In Oakmere, Tobias "Tin" Kaijkrause was a baker. In S-R17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a baker again.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Tobias "Tin" Kaijkrause watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Tobias "Tin" Kaijkrause won his boots at cards from a lance corporal in S-R17. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
kkrogheemil: Nobody saw Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F1, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
A shell knocked in the parapet at S-F1. Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil was dug out of the sandbags bruised, coughing, and furious.

Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

The wound Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more. A letter from home found Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil before the night shift. Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil folded it small and kept it close.
There was never a bed for Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F1 on his own feet.

Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Benedikt Rezasiibiil was grazed. A letter from home found Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil before the night shift. Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil across the shin at S-F1. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Arno "Smokes" Den of the Concord (@ay.den0707). A letter from home found Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil before the night shift. Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil folded it small and kept it close.

The men at S-F1 heard Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Isidor "Saint" Imerv of the Concord (@imerv2). Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil was killed on watch at S-F1. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Isidor "Saint" Imerv of the Concord (@imerv2).

The House of Kkrogheemil sent another. Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil, father of Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil reported for duty as a sapper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it. A letter from home found Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil before the night shift. Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil folded it small and kept it close. Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 311. The men who came later will ask about it.
klekarh_gloose: On Day 9 Lucien Gloose took a post at S-C13 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He shares cigarettes but never smokes, and the men liked him for it.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-C13, Lucien Gloose listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Lucien Gloose warmed the ink bottle inside his tunic. The letter began only when the ink agreed to move. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Lucien Gloose answered to number 714.
londonz_29: After 9 days of war, S-C1 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Oskar Londonz.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Oskar Londonz helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Oskar Londonz fired, and Norbert Kracun was grazed. Oskar Londonz got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 875. The men who came later will ask about it.
nathan156910: Day 9: Oskar "Rabbit" Nathan reached R-C6 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Oskar "Rabbit" Nathan during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-C6. Oskar "Rabbit" Nathan fired at the last man to run. Gideon "Brick" Ham was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Oskar "Rabbit" Nathan answered to number 650.
nm.ogre: Oskar Ogre walked into P-F12 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
A parcel from home held a comb. Oskar Ogre has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
not_ursarte: "You're late," said the corporal when Ivo Ursarte arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
A clear shot from P-F18. Ivo Ursarte grazed Teodor Canales and slid back down below the parapet.
t3mp1ar369: In Brennmoor, Rafael Tmpar was a blacksmith. In T-F2, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a blacksmith again.

At T-F2 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Rafael Tmpar won the bet. Dorian "Whistle" Nathanael was grazed. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F2 with the rations. Rafael Tmpar ate while listening to the revised orders.

Rafael Tmpar was hit in the forearm at T-F2. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Silas "Spark" Tallas of the Hegemony (@tallas154).
tyner_1776: Otto Tyner reached R-S5 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Otto Tyner pulled Wendel Roma out of a flooded shell hole at Lantern Hill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Otto Tyner traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Otto Tyner wrote a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof's mother, because Quentin could not find the words. Quentin signed it.

The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Otto Tyner fought Konrad Mearsiecat in a trench no wider than a door. Otto Tyner came home with Konrad Mearsiecat's cap badge. (@mearsiecat) Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Otto Tyner watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Otto Tyner fired, and Yann Spring was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Otto Tyner answered to number 458.
